inlines.v: MAZE, noun 1. A winding and turning; perplexed state of things; intricacy; a state that embarrasses. The ways of heaven are dark and intricate, Puzzled with mazes, and perplexed with error. 2. Confusion of thought; perplexity; uncertainty. 3. A labyrinth. MAZE, verb transitive To bewilder; to confound with intricacy; to amaze. MAZE, verb intransitive To be bewildered.
